faq: How soon is my site ready?
Usually a few minutes after you pay. We email you when it is. If it’s been more than an hour, send us a message and we’ll look right away.
Can I change my plan or size later?
Yes. Send us a message with your site name and what you’d like, and we’ll switch it for you. The new price starts from your next renewal.
Can I use my own domain?
Yes. Every site starts on a free address. When you’re ready, your account page shows the records to add where your domain is managed, and the secure connection is set up for you.
What happens if I send more emails than my size allows?
Order, account and booking emails always send. Past your monthly allowance, newsletters and email sequences pause until next month.
